name: Schranz (hard German techno)
lineage: Late-1990s and 2000s German hard-techno subgenre characterized by extreme-tempo (140-160 BPM), distorted-industrial-percussion, harsh-aggressive synth textures, and rigid four-on-the-floor beat with minimal melodic content. Chris Liebing, Sven Wittekind, Boris S., and the broader Cologne-Frankfurt-Berlin hard-techno scene defined the canonical aesthetic.
